annotations.title: Suggest which open items settle each other

description: For each open line on a receivable or payable account of one counterparty (a branch and its parent are one party), the lines of the other side on the same account that could settle it, up to three proposals a line: an exact pair, several lines that add up to it to the cent ("this payment settles these three invoices", or one invoice paid in instalments), and — only when nothing is exact — a pair or several lines within the company's difference tolerance, with the difference (the line less the total). Each proposal has a stable proposal_id, a kind (pair, combination), the lines and a sentence. It writes nothing: show the user, then reconcile_many for a difference of 0.00, or reconcile_with_difference once they have seen the difference and chosen a reason.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

contact_id.description: One contact; its branches and its parent count as one party. Left out: every counterparty of the company.
